title: Dimension of the full two-adic Hecke algebra at odd level
exact_target: Fix any odd positive N. For each k take the Z-algebra generated by prime-to-2N Hecke operators $T_l$ and l $S_l$ on the sum of all weight-i level-Gamma1(N) modular forms, including Eisenstein forms, for $1<=i<=k$; here $S_l$ acts in weight i by $l^{i-2}$ times the diamond operator. Complete each algebra by tensoring with Z2 and take their inverse limit under restriction. Must every irreducible component of its spectrum have Krull dimension exactly four?
